verdict.rationale: Training-data opt-out is a fair question for GitHub, which hosts user code and ships AI features (Copilot). However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a control that stops user data from being used for model training. The only related item says Copilot settings can be configured on GitHub, but it never mentions training-data use, so it is an adjacent control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
